title: Lime green, a black tab bar, and a sock puppet
label: Brand gallery
lede: Pets.com was a brand before it was a business: a talking sock puppet with a microphone, a lime-green storefront, a Super Bowl spot and a balloon in the 1999 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. Here are the marks as they survive in the archive, and our drawings in the same spirit.
